Here is the breakdown of the rates for the 6-month stay:

July: AED 4,000
August: AED 4,500
September: AED 5,000
October: AED 6,000
November: AED 7,500
December: AED 8,000

Please note that each month’s booking will be for 30 nights, and a security deposit of AED 1,500 is also required.

Thank you.
